why: Two Seasons of DIFFERENT series: same sequence number, same year, no shared Alt ID. The family gate must rule them ineligible, and nothing in the corpus pinned that. De-Dupe UI rates `eligibility`/`familyId` HIGH severity in 13-conformance.md section 6 -- it selects the weight profile and can clamp a score to the ineligible ceiling or cap it at 79 -- and records that it had ZERO fixtures anywhere, in this corpus or in BMR-Review. The complement already exists: season-resolved-parent-is-comparable pins that two Seasons of the SAME series ARE comparable. Together they pin both directions of the gate, which is what a gate needs -- the positive case alone passes just as happily with the check removed. The invariants are deliberately not a score: verdict_not_in Accept plus a score_max at the ineligible ceiling survive any retune of the weights, whereas a pinned confidence would have to be re-approved every cycle. Note this pair is DELIBERATELY starved of corroboration -- no Alt ID -- because a common Alt ID would legitimately floor it to Review through Guard 7 (the operator's Review-visible ruling), which is a different lesson and wants its own pair.
